artifacts.summary: Conditional model-level tpOf periodicity landed in LadderAgree.lean, the unconditional eventual form compiled FALSE by a new wired probe, and the honest gap recorded in the RaySummary README.

completion_data.completion_summary: Authored tpOf_periodic_of_objAt_periodic and objAt_tpOf_eq_of_objAt_periodic in LadderAgree.lean at their pinned Challenge signatures: the realized stab-free type of a ladder path is l-periodic whenever the path's object walk is globally l-periodic. Compiled the wired probe ladder-tpof-periodicity-refutation.lean showing the unconditional EVENTUAL form (threshold plus period, the satThreshold/satPeriod shape) is FALSE along an arbitrary ladder path, so the hypothesis is load-bearing. Recorded in the RaySummary README that the conditional form does NOT discharge the third circularity, because the tight (doubling) chain's walk is not globally periodic.

metadata.compliance_note: lean-plan-compliance-check.sh reports one finding, '[MISSING] l'. It is a tokenizer artefact: the bare metavariable l was extracted from the Goals block's prose '`l`-periodic' and searched for as a declaration name. Both pinned Challenge identifiers resolve ([OK] tpOf_periodic_of_objAt_periodic, [OK] objAt_tpOf_eq_of_objAt_periodic) and their landed signatures are byte-identical to the plan's pinned statements (hypothesis lists and conclusions unchanged; only the host section's variable binders supplied, which the plan's Binder note permits). Per .claude/rules/plan-compliance.md a mechanical drift finding is ADVISORY and is not on its own grounds to fail the task, so verification_passed stays true; the finding is surfaced here rather than suppressed.
